name: read_design_values
description: Find saved top-level and static design values in lib Dart files: colors, TextStyle typography, numbers, EdgeInsets, BorderRadius and font family strings. Returns up to 200 names, paths, source revisions and expression excerpts. Filter by query, kind or path. This is a bounded syntax index; arbitrary dynamic theme expressions may require reading their Dart source.

name: list_assets
description: List up to 200 app assets with their project-relative paths, media categories, sizes, Flutter registration and font family names from saved pubspec.yaml. Filter by query or category when truncated. Use existing paths or font families when editing Flutter widgets; binary files are not returned as text.

name: component_definition
description: Resolve a project widget component to its class definition using the Dart SDK. Uses the selected instance by default, or its containing component for a build-method widget. A definition includes a source revision and its build widget where available. Read inspect_widgets first. Requires a configured Dart SDK and saved project source.

name: component_references
description: Find up to 200 semantic uses of a project widget component class across the project using the Dart SDK, including constructor calls and type references. Returns scoped source locations, file revisions and excerpts; a widget ID is included for constructor uses visible in the source tree. Read inspect_widgets first. Requires saved project source.

name: read_widget_property
description: Read the full Dart expression for one property of a selected widget, including callbacks and nested constructor values. Use the widget ID and revision from inspect_widgets. Catalog names such as text or fontSize work; other named arguments and dotted paths such as style.letterSpacing are also supported.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit on a project-scoped connection.

name: read_project_rules
description: Read applicable AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md and .cursorrules files. Root rules apply to the project; rules in ancestor directories of path are returned from broadest to closest scope. Large files return marked excerpts. Read this before creating files.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit on a project-scoped connection.

path.description: Optional project-relative file path, including a file that does not exist yet. Omit to read root rules.

name: read_app_logs
description: Read up to the latest 200 lines from this project's preview, device, build, analysis or test command. Debug preview logs include Dart print/debugPrint and framework output while the preview is open in Freeflow. Select target or a jobId; after resumes using nextAfter from the same job. No matching command returns job:null. Excerpts are bounded and may be truncated.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit on a project-scoped connection.

target.description: Defaults to the most recently started app-related command.

jobId.description: Optional specific command ID, overriding target.

name: edit_history
description: Read the next saved project edit available for Undo and Redo, and its history revision. History is kept while Freeflow is running.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit on a project-scoped connection.

name: replay_edit
description: Undo or redo the latest saved project edit. A multi-file change is replayed together. Read edit_history first; external file changes and stale history revisions are rejected.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit on a project-scoped connection.

revision.description: History revision from edit_history, rather than a file revision.

name: list_projects
description: List Flutter projects in the running local Freeflow workbench.

name: list_files
description: List visible Flutter project files. Build caches, symlinks and common credentials are skipped.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit when the MCP connection is scoped to one project.

name: read_file
description: Read UTF-8 source and obtain a revision for conflict-safe writes.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit when the MCP connection is scoped to one project.

path.description: Project-relative path with forward slashes, e.g. lib/main.dart.

name: write_file
description: Create or replace one project file. Read it first and pass its revision to avoid overwriting newer edits.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit when the MCP connection is scoped to one project.

path.description: Project-relative path with forward slashes, e.g. lib/main.dart.

revision.description: Revision returned by read_file. Use null only for a new file.

name: inspect_widgets
description: Read supported widget constructors, properties and editable conditional branch values from a Dart file.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit when the MCP connection is scoped to one project.

path.description: Project-relative path with forward slashes, e.g. lib/main.dart.

name: edit_widget
description: Edit the Dart source through a visual operation. Use IDs and a revision from inspect_widgets.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit when the MCP connection is scoped to one project.

path.description: Project-relative path with forward slashes, e.g. lib/main.dart.

revision.description: Revision returned by read_file. Use null only for a new file.

name.description: Property name for a property or expression edit. Expression edits also support arbitrary named arguments and dotted paths inside explicit constructor calls.

expression.description: One complete Dart expression, up to 64 KiB, for operation expression. Read the existing source or read_widget_property first. This explicitly replaces an existing expression. Dart analysis and compilation determine type correctness.

remove.description: For operation expression, remove the named property to restore its default. Omit expression when true. Positional values cannot be removed.

branch.description: Optional path to an editable conditional value, such as then or else/then. Read the matching conditional from inspect_widgets.

slot.description: Available Dart child slot for add, paste or moving inside a target.

widget.description: Palette widget for add or wrapper type for wrap.

target.description: Destination widget ID for move, in the same Dart file.

code.description: Complete Dart widget constructor for paste. Preserve imports and referenced values in the destination file.

name: start_preview
description: Start the real local Flutter web preview and return its job. Check preview_status for the preview URL.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit when the MCP connection is scoped to one project.

name: preview_status
description: Get the latest local preview status, URL and Flutter logs.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit when the MCP connection is scoped to one project.

name: reload_preview
description: Refresh the running Flutter preview after source edits.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit when the MCP connection is scoped to one project.

name: analyze
description: Run Flutter static analysis. Check job_status when the job finishes.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit when the MCP connection is scoped to one project.

name: test
description: Run Flutter tests. Check job_status when the job finishes.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit when the MCP connection is scoped to one project.

name: build
description: Export a local Flutter build artifact. An iOS IPA requires macOS, Xcode and signing.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit when the MCP connection is scoped to one project.

baseHref.description: Optional web base path such as / or /my-app/.

flavor.description: Optional Android or iOS Flutter flavor.

name: job_status
description: Read status, output and compiler logs for a Freeflow command.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit when the MCP connection is scoped to one project.

jobId.description: Job ID returned by a tool.

name: list_exports
description: List build artifacts available in the Freeflow Export dialog.

projectId.description: Project ID from list_projects. Omit when the MCP connection is scoped to one project.
